description: Need cues with evidence arms (computation, external evidence and both). A Legal MC prompt carries no provision text: a Legal MC question that also asks to compute or compare goes to KS, one that names a legal provision goes to K. A reading question that asks to compute or combine facts goes to S. Every other item stays on B. K and KS have no wide outcome, and on core they exist only for the evidence anchors.

conditions.note: Legal MC question with a calculation_or_combination cue: it needs the provisions and a combination of them
Legal MC question with a legal_provision_outside_input cue
reading question with a calculation_or_combination cue of cue-lexicon-v1; S cannot separate a reading failure from a reasoning one, so it targets both
